The census's error is structural rather than arithmetic: a best-fit register-assignment census scores a fixed positional pairing and has no way to model a permutation, so a residual that is two atoms of emission order plus a clean bijection reads to it as a bijection that does not exist. Treat such a census as a LOWER BOUND on recolor eligibility, never as a verdict.
